description: This file defines an interface named ActionSummary within the namespace OrangeHRM\Dashboard\Dto\ActionSummary. It specifies method signatures for retrieving a group's ID, name, and pending action count, serving as a contract for classes implementing action summary data transfer objects in the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns an integer representing the ID of the action group.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns a string representing the name of the action group.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns an integer representing the count of pending actions in the group.
